nodes.text: Brinna turns and strides off. Delilah seethes for a moment before leaving as well.
Outside, she finds Kimi and Brinna waiting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well? Did she take the bait?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: She sure did.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And do you want to call the prank off?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: No way. This girl's going `down.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No way. This girl's going [color=#3b78e2][i]down.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You're just a `mean` girl! And you try to make being mean sound like being nice... Which makes it even `meaner!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just a [color=#3b78e2][i]mean[/i][/color] girl! And you try to make being mean sound like being nice... Which makes it even [color=#3b78e2][i]meaner![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I just tell the truth. It's not my fault some people can't handle it.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You're awful. There's no way anyone would be happy to see you onstage.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: The sad part is, there's nothing you can do to stop me. If Logan's onstage, I'll be up there singing with him.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Good. I'd genuinely like to see that.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: He's a gentleman and a scholar and maybe he's out of `your` league!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's a gentleman and a scholar and maybe he's out of [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] league!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Sound a little defensive there. Who are you trying to convince, me or yourself?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I don't... That's not...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Uh huh. Look it's been great chatting with you, but I've really gotta go.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: See you on Friday. I'll be the one onstage next to Logan.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hmmph.
Delilah hesitates... And cries out in wordless rage!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: `Rrrraaah!`

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Uh... Use words much?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Rrrr...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Look, it's been great 'chatting', but I'm gonna get out of here before they call security on you.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: See you on Friday. I'll be the one onstage next to Logan.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: In any case, `you` probably shouldn't go up onstage on Friday.
nodes.text_bbcode: In any case, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] probably shouldn't go up onstage on Friday.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Well, Logan has a ton of cute girls around him all the time.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Honestly... and I mean this in the nicest way, really I do... But I don't think this is a competition you would win. You're just `not` his type.
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly... and I mean this in the nicest way, really I do... But I don't think this is a competition you would win. You're just [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] his type.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Type?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Look, the 'Frumpy Farm Girl' vibe might be charming enough for 'eccentric' guys, but this is `Logan.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, the 'Frumpy Farm Girl' vibe might be charming enough for 'eccentric' guys, but this is [color=#3b78e2][i]Logan.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: You're just a smidge out of your league. You're better off sticking with that Ericson kid.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: `What?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Anger boils up inside of Delilah, rising to her throat, until suddenly she shouts...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: He just has this look in his eyes. One that just says...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: 'Come and join me on stage'... You know?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Um. Not really.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, I guess you have to see it for yourself...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: But he only gives the look when he's onstage, and you have to see it up close.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Hmmm... Onstage, huh? Interesting...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hope that was enough to convince her!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You know, that one song he sings that goes...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: {{ Doot doo doo... Come and... Join me on... The stage... Of Life {{

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's a metaphor. Only his true fans know it.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Totally! I picked up on that like, immediately.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Of course I know Logan loves singing with fans on stage.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: By his... Um... Blog? He mentioned it in a recent post.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Logan would never have a blog! He's way too mysterious!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: He... Only blogs under a secret alias!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: OMG... That `is` mysterious.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I guess you might actually be telling the truth...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Logan... Is your friend?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Yeah! Well, basically. We have mutual friends.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh wait a minute... You're Kimi's little buddy! The one who dates the weird guy!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Your name was... Don't tell me! ...Petunia?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Delilah.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Delilah! I knew it was something `rural` like that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Delilah! I knew it was something [color=#3b78e2][i]rural[/i][/color] like that.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Anyway, if you're going to Logan's show to try and impress him, let me save you a little heartache.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Don't.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Logan's got dozens of girls fighting over him. You'd have to do something drastic to stand out.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, it just so happens that I know something all those girls don't.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Y... You do?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Uh huh. I know what he loves the most! He loves it when fans run up on stage and sing along with him!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: And what makes you say that?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, you can tell by his...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm going to a show on Friday, and I want to look my best in the crowd!
Out of the corner of her eye, Delilah notices Brinna turn toward her...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Wait, `this` Friday? You wouldn't happen to mean the show at the Streetlight Lounge, would you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] Friday? You wouldn't happen to mean the show at the Streetlight Lounge, would you?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Actually I would! My friend Logan is playing.
Brinna whips her head toward Delilah.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Um, who are you and why are you ripping off my style?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry, I meant it as a compliment!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm going to a show tomorrow and I wanted to look my best. My friend Logan is playing a set.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Um... Something to make me look...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: ...Old?
The clerk gives her a puzzled look. Brinna scoffs audibly, but makes her way over.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I think the word you're looking for is 'mature'... But if I were you, I wouldn't go that route anyway.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Your lumberjack vibe isn't the most youthful look as it is.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh... Right... Well, I guess I was just going for something new. I'm going to a show on Friday night and wanted to look my best. My friend Logan is playing a set.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's it!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: So, all we gotta do is convince Brinna to barge on stage during Logan's show...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...And her chances with Logan will be `ruined.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And her chances with Logan will be [color=#3b78e2][i]ruined.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: What's perfect?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: You just said 'perfect'. Who you talkin' to?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Myself! I meant... The `weather` is perfect.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Myself! I meant... The [color=#3b78e2][i]weather[/i][/color] is perfect.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Oh... Your headband on a little too tight or something?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Haha, good one! Anyway, gotta go! See ya Friday!
Kimi turns and speed walks away!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah, sure.
You are now playing as Delilah.
Later that day, Delilah, Paige and Kimi meet just outside the mall.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You ready to do this, Delilah?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you sure you don't want to wear the earpiece?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm sure. I think having voices in my ear will only make me more nervous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you still having doubts?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Sure, I just... I just feel weird trying to trick somebody, you know?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, it's sweet that you're so... Well, `sweet,` but you're the only one who can do this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, it's sweet that you're so... Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet,[/i][/color] but you're the only one who can do this.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Brinna knows me and Paige, so she won't believe a word we say.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's probably inside Gigi's, her favorite store. All you have to do is get her attention and start a conversation. Then, casually let it slip that Logan `loves` when fans run up on stage and sing with him.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's probably inside Gigi's, her favorite store. All you have to do is get her attention and start a conversation. Then, casually let it slip that Logan [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] when fans run up on stage and sing with him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And once you do, Brinna will finally feel the humiliation she inflicts on other people every day.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, she's never really done anything to me personally...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll tell you what. After talking to her, if you don't think she's the worst, we can call the prank off.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Kimi!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kimi![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm serious. That's how confident I am that you'll see things our way after five minutes with Brinna.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well... All right. Here goes...
Delilah enters the mall and finds Gigi's, a pristine trendy boutique. She spots Brinna browsing along the far wall.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Gotta get her attention...
Delilah strides up to the counter and addresses the clerk... Speaking loud enough for Brinna to overhear...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hi! I was hoping you could help me. I need a new outfit. Something to make me look...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Poor, poor Logan. Everyone loves you. Must be nice.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Hey, it's not all sunshine and rainbows.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh huh. I'm sure. What could you possibly have to complain about?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: I have fans, sure. But there are a choice few I could do `without.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have fans, sure. But there are a choice few I could do [color=#e23b3b][i]without.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What do they do... Clap offbeat?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: The absolute worst of them are the fans who run up onstage. Even worse is when they `sing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The absolute worst of them are the fans who run up onstage. Even worse is when they [color=#e23b3b][i]sing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? So... You don't like it when fans do that?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: I'm gonna go ahead and say I `hate` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm gonna go ahead and say I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: It's like, the fans came to see a show. Are you so desperate for attention that you have to ruin the show for everyone else?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Interesting. Well, I sincerely hope no one is dumb enough to do that at your show.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Yeah. Me too.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean? My music only appeals to annoying people?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No! I just meant...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: That I draw a lame crowd?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No! Just that... I dunno, people can do weird stuff when they go all fangirl...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Oh. Why didn't you just say that then? Yeah, they totally do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whew!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Any particularly bad fan stories?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Well, not really one story... But there is one thing I hate in general...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: It's fans that run up on stage during a show. Even worse is when they `sing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's fans that run up on stage during a show. Even worse is when they [color=#e23b3b][i]sing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: It's like, the fans came to see a `show.` Are you so desperate for attention that you have to ruin the experience for everyone else?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like, the fans came to see a [color=#e23b3b][i]show.[/i][/color] Are you so desperate for attention that you have to ruin the experience for everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right. How embarrassing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, my point is, it must be pretty intense performing in front of a live crowd.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Yeah. You get all types. Fangirls, music buffs...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: With all that attention...

options.label: You must have some annoying fans.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't take your bitterness out on me just cuz you're just a loner!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Whoa! Relax! Did I strike nerve or something?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: No need to get defensive, I was just joking around.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh! Um... Right.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Yikes... Maybe you should just move on, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... Find out his pet peeve and get out of there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thousands of 'likes' on my video channel can't be wrong.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Ha! You got me there! So the Fashionista's got jokes. Who knew?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Keep up. Maybe you'll learn something.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, you two are getting along like frogs on a log!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's warming up to you, Kimi. Try to find out his pet peeve!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ask about his show!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Be casual, and jokey...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: But not mean!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I heard you're putting on a show on Friday.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Yeah, at the Streetlight Lounge. What about it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How'd you get that gig?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Used to bus tables there. The owner was pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Cool. You know, I have some experience performing too.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Yeah... I heard about that. That viral video of you singing. Not the most flattering work, from what they say.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Maybe you're just jealous that I have...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Whoa!
Logan pats the motorcycle as if to comfort it...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `Esperanza` is a classic!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Esperanza[/i][/color] is a classic!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, but a classic `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but a classic [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Ha! ...All right, I'll admit, she's got some years on her.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: I'm surprised. Most people don't have the guts to talk to me that way. They either keep their distance or they suck up and try to be all buddy-buddy with me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, you know. That's not my style.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nicely done, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: So what's up?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We haven't really gotten to talk yet. You know, get to know each other!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Riiight... So, favor or number?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Anyone being `this` nice to me either wants a favor or wants my number. So which is it, Fashionista?
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyone being [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] nice to me either wants a favor or wants my number. So which is it, Fashionista?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: You lookin' for a prom date? Or maybe just a ride on `Esperanza` here?
nodes.text_bbcode: You lookin' for a prom date? Or maybe just a ride on [color=#e23b3b][i]Esperanza[/i][/color] here?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't... But I wasn't... That's not...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: That was downright impolite of him...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: All right, all right. So spill it. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So how do we find out that information?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Can't we just go up and ask him?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, sure. 'Hi there, hot, mysterious guy we just met! What do you hate more than anything else in the world?' That should go over `great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, sure. 'Hi there, hot, mysterious guy we just met! What do you hate more than anything else in the world?' That should go over [color=#3b78e2][i]great.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Actually, that's not necessarily a bad plan...
Later that afternoon, Kimi follows Logan out to the parking lot, where he takes a seat on an old, weathered motorcycle. She adjusts her wireless earpiece...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can you guys hear me?
In a nearby car, Paige and Delilah respond on their cellphones.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: We can hear you fine, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just make sure to cover the earpiece with your hair, so Logan doesn't see it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Got it. I see Logan.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm nervous. Why am I nervous? How am I supposed to get information out of him?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Just be real friendly!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! Kimi, be `cool.` If he insults you, insult him right back.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Kimi, be [color=#3b78e2][i]cool.[/i][/color] If he insults you, insult him right back.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: That doesn't seem nice at all!
Just then, Logan looks up to notice Kimi.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Hey. The Fashionista.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh? Uh... Hi!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: You following me, or did you just take a wrong turn on the runway?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... Uh... Just wanted to...

options.label: See that rust bucket you call a bike.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: And... How will that help exactly?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That way, we can offer Logan something he wants, and he'll realize how much he `doesn't` want Brinna!
nodes.text_bbcode: That way, we can offer Logan something he wants, and he'll realize how much he [color=#3b78e2][i]doesn't[/i][/color] want Brinna!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can see that you are so `very` new to the revenge game.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can see that you are so [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] new to the revenge game.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The plan's a work in progress.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look. Why beat around the bush? We should find out what he `hates` and get him to associate that with Brinna!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look. Why beat around the bush? We should find out what he [color=#3b78e2][i]hates[/i][/color] and get him to associate that with Brinna!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's a much better plan.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If we do that, we can trick Brinna into becoming Logan's worst nightmare! She'll be shot down for sure!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then we'll see who's 'undateable'!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooh, that is `good,` Kimi.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, that is [color=#3b78e2][i]good,[/i][/color] Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, so how exactly do you plan to get revenge?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We need to embarrass Brinna in front of Logan... But somewhere `public...`
nodes.text_bbcode: We need to embarrass Brinna in front of Logan... But somewhere [color=#3b78e2][i]public...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean like at the show on Friday?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What show?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Logan's playing a gig at the Streetlight Lounge on Friday.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And how do `you` know this, Erik?
nodes.text_bbcode: And how do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] know this, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I 'liked' his fanpage online... Didn't you guys?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I haven't heard any of his music.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me neither. But he just looks like he has that 'x-factor', know what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, no. But at least you've found out our 'where' and 'when'. Now we just need the 'how'...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd help, but I get the feeling this isn't the kind of problem I can punch.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, but no thanks, Spencer. This will take some subtlety.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I think we girls got this. It's been too long since I've plotted some good old fashioned `revenge.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I think we girls got this. It's been too long since I've plotted some good old fashioned [color=#3b78e2][i]revenge.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It'll be like a Girls Night Out kinda thing.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm afraid I won't be able to join you in your quest for vengeance. I have a Book Club meeting to prepare for.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! Delilah, you should join them!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! Some good ol' fashioned Troublemakers hijinks will be a great opportunity for you and the girls to bond!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well... I guess it might be... Fun?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Awesome. You're gonna love it. Let's go!
Paige takes Kimi and Delilah by their arms and hurries off excitedly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh... Well, see you later then?
Erik waves.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You girls have fun on your vengeance quest! Byyye!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, first things first. If we're gonna embarrass Brinna in front of Logan, we'll need some more info...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right. We need to find out what Logan...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In case you've forgotten, Brinna had pigs chase me on stage under a big `'undateable'` sign... She completely humiliated me in front of the entire school!
nodes.text_bbcode: In case you've forgotten, Brinna had pigs chase me on stage under a big [color=#3b78e2][i]'undateable'[/i][/color] sign... She completely humiliated me in front of the entire school!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She needs to know I'm not a pushover. She needs a dose of her own medicine!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now `that's` what I'm talking about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] what I'm talking about!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No one's `really` gonna get hurt, Delilah.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one's [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] gonna get hurt, Delilah.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: But weren't `you` hurt when Brinna pulled that prank on you?
nodes.text_bbcode: But weren't [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] hurt when Brinna pulled that prank on you?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You know, when she had pigs chase you onstage, under a big `'undateable'` sign?
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, when she had pigs chase you onstage, under a big [color=#3b78e2][i]'undateable'[/i][/color] sign?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, yeah... And I didn't need the reminder, BTW...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, this is the whole point! Of `course` Brinna's gonna get hurt.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, this is the whole point! Of [color=#3b78e2][i]course[/i][/color] Brinna's gonna get hurt.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But Kimi has to prove that she's no pushover. Otherwise, girls like Brinna are just gonna keep walking all over her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No offense, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: None taken.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I guess I see what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Doesn't that seem a little... Mean?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Trust me. In this case, revenge is totally...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Brinna doesn't need a reason to be horrible! She's just `horrible!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Brinna doesn't need a reason to be horrible! She's just [color=#3b78e2][i]horrible![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure that logic is sound. Are you sure you're not just biased against her?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm not biased! Brinna's stupid `face` is biased!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not biased! Brinna's stupid [color=#3b78e2][i]face[/i][/color] is biased!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa, rein it in there, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It looks like she spilled it after those girls went all googly-eyed over Logan.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh right... Brinna `does` seem to have a crush on Logan.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh right... Brinna [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] seem to have a crush on Logan.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well then why didn't you say so?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `That's` how you're going to get revenge on Brinna.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] how you're going to get revenge on Brinna.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She only spilled her drink on those girls to get them away from Logan. She totally has a crush on him!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then `that's` how we get revenge on her! We embarrass her in front of him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] how we get revenge on her! We embarrass her in front of him!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: My thoughts exactly!
Kimi's feet slide in the thick puddle of milkshake...
...But she steadies her feet and keeps from falling!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whew!
...She has failed.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Kevin! Wait!
But the ruckus of the venue is too loud, and Kimi is too far away!
Oblivious, Kevin turns and walks through the exit! Moments later, the lounge's owner takes the mic onstage and regretfully informs the crowd that the show has been cancelled.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But... But... You `can't` cancel the show!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... But... You [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] cancel the show!

nodes.text: There is a collective groan from the crowd, and all at  once, they surge toward the exit!
Kimi is swept aside by the sudden tide of people! She knocks into a trash can and stumbles!
On the floor, she begins digging herself out of the pile of overturned garbage, when suddenly...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: You all right there, Fashionista?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh... I'm fine, I just--

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: 'Fashionista'? You mean Pig Girl?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Brinna?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Brinna?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kimi looks up to find Brinna clinging tightly to Logan's arm, a smug smile on her face!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Don't worry about her, Logan. I actually think she's in her element down there.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Kimi, I'd love to stay and help you clean up, really I would...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: But now that Logan's show is cancelled, he and I are going for a ride on his bike. He said he would teach me some guitar chords later.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Whatever. Anyway, see ya later, Kimi.
As the two of them leave arm-in-arm, Kimi can do nothing but sit on the floor and seethe!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Rrrrgh! Brinna!
Kimi grits her teeth, paralyzed with anger! In the churning pit of her stomach, she knows...
Later, the show is underway as Logan churns out a grungy, driving tune on his guitar while the whole crowd rocks out, bobbing to the music!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `{{ Esperanza! Don't turn your back on me, Esperanza! {{

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Go Logan!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you were able to get the show back on track so quickly, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I had some help.
Over in the corner, manning a sound system control panel, Kevin gives her a thumbs up.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh, I think Logan's about to perform his finale!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then let's hope Brinna performs `hers...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then let's hope Brinna performs [color=#3b78e2][i]hers...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Thank you all for coming. I got one more for you. It's called 'Tank Top Girl'.
Girls in the crowd squeal with delight. In the front row, Brinna's eyes light up deviously as she shoves her way to the edge of the stage...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `{{ Tank Top Girl...{{`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]{{ Tank Top Girl...{{[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `{{ You were my only vice... {{`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]{{ You were my only vice... {{[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, Brinna climbs onstage, pumping her fist to the music as she sidles up beside Logan!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `{{ How do you burn so hot... {{`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]{{ How do you burn so hot... {{[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: `{{ WHEN I SWEAR YOU'RE MADE OF IIIIIICE!!! {{`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]{{ WHEN I SWEAR YOU'RE MADE OF IIIIIICE!!! {{[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Microphone feedback screeches as Brinna wails an off-key high note! Logan stops strumming to plug his ears, and the whole crowd grimaces!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: What happened to the music? This is where you come in, Logan!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Pretty sure this is where you `get out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Pretty sure this is where you [color=#e23b3b][i]get out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The crowd begins to chuckle.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Appreciate the backup, but these people came to see a `solo` act.
nodes.text_bbcode: Appreciate the backup, but these people came to see a [color=#e23b3b][i]solo[/i][/color] act.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I don't care about these people! This is about you and me! About our duet!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Oh, 'duet' is a generous word for whatever `that` was.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, 'duet' is a generous word for whatever [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was.

nodes.text: The crowd laughs even louder now.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: But... But this was supposed to be `our` moment!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... But this was supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] moment!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: No, this was supposed to be a show, until you ruined it by being an attention-hungry diva.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Actually, I take that back. Divas can `sing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, I take that back. Divas can [color=#e23b3b][i]sing.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The crowd ooh's before erupting into a roar of laughter!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Ugghh!!
Brinna leaves the stage, fuming as she stomps through the crowd, until...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Something wrong, Brinna?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pretty bold move, jumping up onstage like that. Don't you know Logan `hates` when fans do that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Pretty bold move, jumping up onstage like that. Don't you know Logan [color=#3b78e2][i]hates[/i][/color] when fans do that?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Yeah. Where would you get a silly idea like that?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: You... And you?! Kimi, this was all `your` doing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You... And you?! Kimi, this was all [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] doing?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's right. And don't worry. I didn't make an `undateable` sign for you... But I think Logan got the message loud and clear.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right. And don't worry. I didn't make an [color=#3b78e2][i]undateable[/i][/color] sign for you... But I think Logan got the message loud and clear.

nodes.text: Brinna's face flushes red with fury!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: `AAARRGH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AAARRGH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The crowd snickers as Brinna storms off, livid and grumbling!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Music to my ears.
Later, Kimi and the girls leave the venue as the show ends.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All in all, I'd say that was a successful night.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Definitely.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Delilah's giving me a ride home. See ya on Monday, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yup!
Paige and Delilah walk off down the street.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: That was so much fun! Can we get some `more` revenge next week?
nodes.text_bbcode: That was so much fun! Can we get some [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] revenge next week?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Patience, Little One. All in due time.
As Kimi waits for her ride, the last few people trickle out of the lounge, until all that remains in the parking lot is an old motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: You're still here? I would think a nice girl like you had an early curfew.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well... It's not `that` early.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] early.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: And you're not exactly 'nice'. I pieced together what happened with that girl. You set her up for embarrassment, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, the thing you've got to understand is--

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: --Did she deserve it?
Kimi pauses, taken aback for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Yes.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Then I understand all I need to. You know, you might be tougher than I thought. Remind me not to get on your bad side.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What makes you think you haven't already?
Logan smirks. He walks over to his old motorcycle and mounts up, slinging his guitar bag onto his back.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: So you need a ride or something?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On `Esperanza?` No way. That hunk of junk is one speed bump away from falling apart.
nodes.text_bbcode: On [color=#3b78e2][i]Esperanza?[/i][/color] No way. That hunk of junk is one speed bump away from falling apart.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Heh. Must not be so junky if you've started calling her by her name.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're right. She's too good for you.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Ha!
Logan revs the engine of his motorcycle to life.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Later, Kimi.
Putting on his helmet, he shifts into gear and motors away.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. Later.

Kimi's feet slide in the thick puddle of milkshake...
...And slip out from underneath her! She falls to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh! Gross!
Kimi gets up, wiping the shake from her clothes as she tries to make up for lost time!
Just ahead, Kevin turns and makes for the door, unaware of Kimi's advance...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Kevin! Hold up!
Kimi sprints forward, when another patron knocks into a nearby table... And spills a milkshake onto the floor in front of her!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Kimi steps into the slippery mush!
Kimi leans back as far as she can, the tray swinging just inches away from her face!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa! That was close!
Kimi tries to duck low...
But the tray knocks into the top of her head!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ow!
Glasses topple, spilling water everywhere!
Kimi staggers, continuing on her way half-stunned and damp!
Kimi freezes up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh...
Suddenly, the tray knocks into her!
Once past the mass of people, Kimi continues toward the exit...
...When suddenly, a server carrying a tray full of beverages pivots into her path!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aah!
Thinking fast, Kimi...
Kimi crouches low and squeezes through the crowd, pushing past people's knees! People murmur in protest!
She tries to crawl through the maze of legs, when a foot steps on her back!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ow!
Kimi is flattened to the floor! Pulling and scraping she pulls herself up and out of the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not my best idea...
Kimi climbs on top of a nearby table, stretches out her arms...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Woo! Rock and roll!
She leaps onto the crowd...
...And a dozen hands catch her and raise her up! The crowd cheers as Kimi is passed along, as if floating on a tide!
They set her down as she reaches the end of the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've always wanted to do that!
Kimi hesitates, before finally squeaking in a timid voice...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um... Excuse me? ...Pardon me?
The crowd ignores her! Finally, she leans into the crowd and pushes her way through.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Anyway... I'll see you inside?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah!
Kimi makes her way into the crowded lounge.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Kimi! There you are! Where have you been?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was just outside. What's up? Did Brinna not show up?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh, she's here all right...
Kimi looks to the front of the room, where Brinna shoulders her way through the crowd, rubbing elbows with a gaggle of excited female fans. She looks them up and down and scoffs.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Looks like everything's in place. What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: The problem is the show is being delayed!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, Logan was supposed to take the stage, but he hasn't come out yet!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh... There's no way I'm letting this go south because of `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... There's no way I'm letting this go south because of [color=#3b78e2][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kimi marches through the crowd, and straight to the back room...
...Where she finds Logan pacing back and forth!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: I told you I don't--

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Oh! It's you.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: What are `you` doing back here, Fashionista? If you're trying to get a moment alone with me, now's not a good time.
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing back here, Fashionista? If you're trying to get a moment alone with me, now's not a good time.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was just wondering why you aren't out there on stage!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Believe me, it's not by choice.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then what is it?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: The sound system is on the fritz. With that thing busted, there's no way I can do the show.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: And the owner of this place says that if there's not a performance going on in five minutes, the show is `cancelled!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the owner of this place says that if there's not a performance going on in five minutes, the show is [color=#e23b3b][i]cancelled![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, can't you fix the sound system?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Do I look like an AV nerd to you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, don't you know anyone who can fix it?

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Well, I don't exactly roll with an entourage.

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: Look, it's real cute that you were excited for my show, but unless you got some kinda tech expert in your pocket, this gig is a bust.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I `do` know a tech expert!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute... I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] know a tech expert!

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just get ready for your set. I'll handle the rest!
Kimi rushes back out into the main room of the lounge.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's even more crowded than before!
Across the sea of people, Kimi spots the person she's looking for...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Kevin!
She calls to him, but her voice is drowned out by the clamor of the crowd! Kevin only sighs, checks the time on his phone, and turns toward the exit.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait!
Kimi rushes after him... But is blocked by a throng of clubgoers!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This crowd is way too thick! I've got to...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Let's just say I have some unfinished business with her.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ugh. After what she pulled at the dance, I don't blame you. If there's anything I can do to help, just let me know.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Brinna's the worst.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That definitely seems to be the theme of the week. And thanks, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've been looking forward to his show for a `long` time...
nodes.text_bbcode: I've been looking forward to his show for a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] time...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh... Of course. Not surprising. All the girls love Logan.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh! No, I didn't mean it like `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! No, I didn't mean it like [color=#3b78e2][i]that...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's fine, Kimi... No need to explain, really.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not that! It's more about Brinna.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You love `Brinna?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You love [color=#e23b3b][i]Brinna?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, I have plans to get back at Brinna for what happened at the Winter Dance.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh! Well, in that case, I'm behind you 100 percent. I hope she gets what's coming to her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm here for... Uh... The nachos.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Nachos? I come here all the time, and I've never seen anyone with nachos.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um... It's on the secret menu. So secret not even the staff knows about it... So if you order them don't be surprised if they just look at you like you're crazy.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: 'Nachos', huh? You know, if you don't want to tell me, you don't have to.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: But I hope you know you don't have to lie to me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No! It's not that, it's just... A long story I guess.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Say no more. Anyway, I just want you to know you can trust me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure. Thanks, Kevin.
Later that week, on Friday night...
Kimi takes her place at the end of a long line outside the Streetlight Lounge. Music and laughter spill onto the street from inside the packed venue.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hope I'm not late!
Suddenly, a familiar voice calls to her.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Kevin? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh, I usually check out the music acts at this venue. It helps me find new artists to sample.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So you're getting back into DJing?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah! More than ever. The staff at this place knows me. I've helped repair their sound system in the past, so they let me DJ events from time to time.

nodes.text: Wow. The Kevin I dated didn't care about anything but playing video games on a Friday night.

The next week, during wrestling practice in the Wilson High gym...
The coach blows his whistle as Owen pins an opponent to the mat!
Owen shakes hands with his training partner and takes a seat next to Skazz on the bench.
Owen, that was `awesome,` man! A German suplex into the pin? That's straight TV stuff, man! You're definitely on a roll!
Well, I have been working hard. You never know if a college scout will visit the next meet!
Forget college scouts, man. I'm talking about winning the state championship!
You've got a real shot at it, if you're willing to work for it.
Ha! Yeah, well, I'll cross that bridge when I get to it. Landing a scholarship is my priority right now.
And you don't think 'State Champion' is gonna get colleges' attention?
I guess you have a point there.
But what am I supposed to do differently? I'm already training as hard as I can.
No no no... You're training to `be` the best. If you're going to win State, you have to train to `beat` the best.
Is that from an inspirational poster?
I'm being real, bro. I'm privy to some pretty choice intel. I know who's the `favorite` to win state.
No one knows his real name. He goes to some tiny private school. But rumor has it, he's undefeated, and a bunch of college scouts are fighting over him.
They say he won his first varsity match... When he was `twelve!`
They say his coach brought in a bear for him to wrestle because no one else posed any competition!
They say the last guy he wrestled ended up with a full-body cast over half his body!
That last one doesn't even make sense! Skazz, I get it. He wins a lot. No need to exaggerate.
It's not exaggeration. He `has` to win.
They say it's a psychological condition. Like if he stops winning, his brain shuts down and he `dies.`
I'm pretty sure `that` one is an exaggeration.
Well, whatever the truth is, everyone agrees on one thing. This guy is no joke.
You've gotta give it a hundred and ten percent. Are you sure you're ready to commit to this?
At least, I'm pretty sure I am...

nodes.title: Kimi Strikes Back
nodes.subtitle: Can Kimi get revenge on Brinna?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Kimi.
It's morning at Twin Branches, and Kimi makes her way through the crowded hallway to her locker.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi! Over here!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey!
Kimi approaches her friends when someone bumps into her shoulder, making her drop her books!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Whoa! In a hurry much? You should slow down.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You did that on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Hey, it's not my fault you were charging through the halls like someone was ringing a dinner bell. It's not lunchtime `yet,` Pig Girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, it's not my fault you were charging through the halls like someone was ringing a dinner bell. It's not lunchtime [color=#3b78e2][i]yet,[/i][/color] Pig Girl.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Get lost, Brinna.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: You know, you're so not-cute when you're angry.
Brinna saunters off smugly...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Rrrr!
Kimi collects her books and stomps over to end of the hall where $ALLISON waits for her along with Owen, Paige, and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa. I'd say good morning... but I have a feeling you'd disagree.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, what's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh, it's Brinna. Being horrible as always.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Need us to tell her to back off?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I offer the same... In a non-violent capacity. I've learned judo should be a last resort...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, I think I might have something even `better` in store for Brinna.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I think I might have something even [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] in store for Brinna.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooh, I smell a payback scheme! I want `on` this train, Kimi.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, I smell a payback scheme! I want [color=#3b78e2][i]on[/i][/color] this train, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um... Paige, don't you think you should cool it with the revenge plots? You took down the entire cheer squad, remember?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe you should lie low for a while...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But this is purely an advisory thing! I'm helping out a friend!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I can't socially destroy my enemies, I should at `least` be able to live vicariously through Kimi while `she` does it!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I can't socially destroy my enemies, I should at [color=#3b78e2][i]least[/i][/color] be able to live vicariously through Kimi while [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] does it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's a very bleak way to put it...
Just then, Erik and Delilah arrive.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, guys!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Mind if we sit with y'all?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of course not. Looks like the gang's all here.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, not `all` here. Technically, Logan's one of the Troublemakers now, isn't he?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, not [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] here. Technically, Logan's one of the Troublemakers now, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, but it looks like Logan's got enough company as it is.
The group all turns their attention across the hall, where Logan sits on a bench, strumming a guitar.
Half a dozen girls fawn over him, smiling and blushing as he sings a few lines...

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `{{ Tank Top Girl, you were my only vice... {{`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]{{ Tank Top Girl, you were my only vice... {{[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: LOGAN
nodes.text: `{{ How do you burn so hot, when I swear you're made of iiiiice! {{`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]{{ How do you burn so hot, when I swear you're made of iiiiice! {{[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The girls sigh and sway along to the rhythm...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: This song, it's sooo deep! You must have gone through so much when you were writing it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Was the song based on a real life 'Tank Top Girl'? Because, I've been known to wear a tank top from time to time...
Just then, Brinna walks up to the gaggle of girls with a cup in her hand... She knocks into Hannah, spilling an iced latte all over her clothes!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aah!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh my gosh. I'm `so` sorry, Hannah! That top must be super hard to replace since `no one` wears those anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry, Hannah! That top must be super hard to replace since [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] wears those anymore.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They... They don't?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh, no one stylish anyway. But maybe Nicole can help you find one at that `bargain bin` place she always shops at.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, no one stylish anyway. But maybe Nicole can help you find one at that [color=#3b78e2][i]bargain bin[/i][/color] place she always shops at.

nodes.text: The crowd chuckles as Hannah and Nicole storm off, embarrassed. Brinna walks away in turn, hiding a smirk.
Back at the Troublemakers' table, Kimi turns to the others.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you guys see that! Brinna spilled that drink on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you certain? What would possess her to do that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She did it...
